description: This source file defines the PostObject class which facilitates signed POST uploads to Amazon S3. It manages form attributes, inputs, policies, and signatures necessary for secure file uploads, encapsulating the complexity of S3 POST form generation.

classes.name: PostObject
classes.description: A class representing a pre-signed POST upload form for Amazon S3, handling form data, policies, and signatures for secure uploads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PostObject with client, bucket, form inputs, and JSON policy, setting up form attributes and inputs including credential-based signatures.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the S3 client used for generating the POST form.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified S3 bucket.

methods.name: getFormAttributes
methods.description: Returns the array of form attributes used in the POST request.

methods.name: setFormAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific form attribute to a new value.

methods.name: getFormInputs
methods.description: Returns the associative array of form inputs for the POST request.

methods.name: setFormInput
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific form input field.

methods.name: getJsonPolicy
methods.description: Returns the raw JSON policy document as a string.

methods.name: generateUri
methods.description: Generates the form action URI based on the client configuration and bucket name.

methods.name: getPolicyAndSignature
methods.description: Generates the base64-encoded policy and signature using credentials for embedding in form inputs.
